name: imposition-toolkit
description: Client-side PDF imposition & pre-press toolkit — 38 print-production tools (booklets, n-up, cards, labels, tickets, folding, marks) that run entirely in the browser via pdf-lib. Framework-agnostic engine + optional React 19 UI.

scripts.build: esbuild src/impose.ts --format=esm --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/impose.mjs && tsc src/impose.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --skipLibCheck --moduleResolution bundler --module esnext --target es2020 --outDir dist
